celaleyn:136-136.t: ﴿وَجَعَلُوا﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca, ﴿لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ﴾ He created ﴿مِنَ الْحَرْثِ﴾ crops ﴿وَالْأَنْعَامِ نَصِيبًا﴾ which they spend on guests and the poor, and for their partners a share which they spend on their [the idols'] custodians. ﴿فَقَالُوا هَذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ﴾ with fatḥa and with ḍamma [بِزُعْمِهِمْ] ﴿وَهَذَا لِشُرَكَائِنَا﴾ So whenever something of their [the idols'] share fell into Allah's share, they picked it out; or if something of His share fell into their share, they left it, and said: "Allah has no need of this," as the Exalted said: ﴿فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَائِهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. to His side, ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلَى شُرَكَائِهِمْ سَاءَ﴾ evil is ﴿مَا يَحْكُمُونَ﴾ i.e. this judgement of theirs.

celaleyn:137-137.t: ﴿وَكَذَلِكَ﴾ just as what has been mentioned was made attractive to them, ﴿زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَادِهِمْ﴾ by burying [daughters] alive, ﴿شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ﴾ of the jinn — in the nominative, the fāʿil (agent) of زَيَّنَ. In one reading [it is] with it [the verb] in the passive, قَتْل in the nominative, الْأَوْلَاد in the accusative by it [the maṣdar], and شُرَكَائِهِمْ in the genitive by its being the muḍāf ilayhi of it [قَتْل]; in it there is a separation between the muḍāf and the muḍāf ilayhi by the object, and that does no harm; and the killing is attributed to the partners because they commanded it. ﴿لِيُرْدُوهُمْ﴾ to destroy them ﴿وَلِيَلْبِسُوا﴾ and to confuse ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾

celaleyn:138-138.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا هَذِهِ أَنْعَامٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ﴾ forbidden; ﴿لَا يَطْعَمُهَا إِلَّا مَنْ نَشَاءُ﴾ of the servants of the idols and others, ﴿بِزَعْمِهِمْ﴾ i.e. they have no proof for it; ﴿وَأَنْعَامٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا﴾ so they are not ridden, like the sāʾiba and the ḥāmī; ﴿وَأَنْعَامٌ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا﴾ when slaughtering them, but rather mention the name of their idols — and they attributed that to Allah — ﴿افْتِرَاءً عَلَيْهِ سَيَجْزِيهِمْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ against Him.

celaleyn:139-139.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا مَا فِي بُطُونِ هَذِهِ الْأَنْعَامِ﴾ the forbidden ones, namely the sāʾibas and the baḥīras, ﴿خَالِصَةٌ﴾ lawful ﴿لِذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِنَا﴾ i.e. the women; ﴿وَإِنْ تَكُنْ مَيْتَةٌ﴾ in the nominative and the accusative, with the verb feminine and masculine [يَكُنْ مَيْتَةً], ﴿فَهُمْ فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ سَيَجْزِيهِمْ﴾ Allah ﴿وَصْفَهُمْ﴾ that [claim] of declaring lawful and forbidden, i.e. the recompense for it. ﴿إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ﴾ in His making, ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ of His creation.

celaleyn:140-140.t: ﴿قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ قَتَلُوا﴾ with the lighter form and with shadda [قَتَّلُوا] ﴿أَوْلَادَهُمْ﴾ by burying them alive, ﴿سَفَهًا﴾ in ignorance, ﴿بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا مَا رَزَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ of what has been mentioned, ﴿افْتِرَاءً عَلَى اللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا وَمَا كَانُوا مُهْتَدِينَ﴾

celaleyn:141-141.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ﴾ created ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ gardens ﴿مَعْرُوشَاتٍ﴾ spread out on the ground, like melons, ﴿وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَاتٍ﴾ in that they rise upon a trunk, like palm trees; ﴿وَ﴾ He produced ﴿النَّخْلَ وَالزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُ﴾ its fruit and its grain, in form and taste, ﴿وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَابِهًا﴾ in their leaves — a ḥāl (circumstantial) — ﴿وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَابِهٍ﴾ in their taste. ﴿كُلُوا مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ إِذَا أَثْمَرَ﴾ before ripening, ﴿وَآتُوا حَقَّهُ﴾ its zakāt ﴿يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِ﴾ with fatḥa and with kasra [حِصَادِهِ]: of the tenth or half of it. ﴿وَلَا تُسْرِفُوا﴾ by giving all of it, so that nothing remains for your dependants. ﴿إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ those who exceed what has been set for them.

celaleyn:142-142.t: ﴿وَ﴾ He produced ﴿مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ حَمُولَةً﴾ fit for carrying loads, like full-grown camels, ﴿وَفَرْشًا﴾ not fit for it, like young camels and sheep; they are called farsh because they are like a carpet (farsh) on the ground, being close to it. ﴿كُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ﴾ his ways of forbidding and permitting; ﴿إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear in enmity.

celaleyn:143-143.t: ﴿ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ﴾ kinds — a badal (substitute) of حَمُولَةً and فَرْشًا — ﴿مِنَ الضَّأْنِ﴾ two of a pair, ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ male and female, ﴿وَمِنَ الْمَعْزِ﴾ with fatḥa and with sukūn [الْمَعَزِ] ﴿اثْنَيْنِ قُلْ﴾ O Muhammad, to those who forbade the males of livestock at one time and their females at another, and attributed that to Allah: ﴿آلذَّكَرَيْنِ﴾ of the sheep and goats ﴿حَرَّمَ﴾ Allah for you ﴿أَمِ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ﴾ of the two, ﴿أَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ﴾ whether male or female? ﴿نَبِّئُونِي بِعِلْمٍ﴾ about how that was forbidden, ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ﴾ in it. The meaning is: where did the prohibition come from? If it were on account of maleness, then all males would be forbidden; or of femaleness, then all females; or of being contained in the womb, then both of the pair. So where does the singling out come from? The interrogative is for disapproval (inkār).

celaleyn:144-144.t: ﴿وَمِنَ الْإِبِلِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ الْبَقَرِ اثْنَيْنِ قُلْ آلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ أَمْ﴾ rather (bal) ﴿كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ﴾ present ﴿إِذْ وَصَّاكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهَذَا﴾ prohibition, so that you relied on that? No — rather you are lying about it. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا﴾ in that ﴿لِيُضِلَّ النَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾

celaleyn:145-145.t: ﴿قُلْ لَا أَجِدُ فِيمَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ﴾ anything ﴿مُحَرَّمًا عَلَى طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ﴾ with yāʾ and with tāʾ [تَكُونَ] ﴿مَيْتَةً﴾ in the accusative, and in one reading in the nominative with the lower-dotted letter [يَكُونَ مَيْتَةٌ], ﴿أَوْ دَمًا مَسْفُوحًا﴾ flowing, unlike other [blood] such as the liver and the spleen, ﴿أَوْ لَحْمَ خِنْزِيرٍ فَإِنَّهُ رِجْسٌ﴾ forbidden, ﴿أَوْ﴾ unless it be ﴿فِسْقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ﴾ i.e. slaughtered in the name of other than Him. ﴿فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ﴾ to anything of what has been mentioned and ate it, ﴿غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٌ﴾ to him for what he ate, ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ toward him. Added to what has been mentioned, by the Sunna, is every beast of prey with fangs and every bird with talons.

celaleyn:146-146.t: ﴿وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوا﴾ i.e. the Jews ﴿حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِي ظُفُرٍ﴾ that is, whatever does not have separated toes, like camels and ostriches; ﴿وَمِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَالْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُومَهُمَا﴾ the omentum and the kidney fat, ﴿إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتْ ظُهُورُهُمَا﴾ i.e. what of it clings to them, ﴿أَوْ﴾ what is carried by ﴿الْحَوَايَا﴾ the intestines — the plural of حَاوِيَاء or حَاوِيَة — ﴿أَوْ مَا اخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ﴾ of it, which is the fat of the tail, for that was made lawful for them. ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ prohibition ﴿جَزَيْنَاهُمْ﴾ with it ﴿بِبَغْيِهِمْ﴾ because of their wrongdoing, as stated earlier in Sūrat al-Nisāʾ. ﴿وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ﴾ in Our reports and Our promises.

celaleyn:147-147.t: ﴿فَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ﴾ in what you have brought, ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿رَبُّكُمْ ذُو رَحْمَةٍ وَاسِعَةٍ﴾ in that He has not hastened punishment upon you — and in this there is gentleness in calling them to faith — ﴿وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُهُ﴾ His punishment, when it comes, ﴿عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾

celaleyn:148-148.t: ﴿سَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا أَشْرَكْنَا﴾ we ﴿وَلَا آبَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ so our associating and our forbidding are by His will, and therefore He is pleased with it. The Exalted says: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ just as these have denied, ﴿كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ their messengers, ﴿حَتَّى ذَاقُوا بَأْسَنَا قُلْ هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ مِنْ عِلْمٍ﴾ that Allah is pleased with that, ﴿فَتُخْرِجُوهُ لَنَا﴾ i.e. you have no knowledge. ﴿إِنْ﴾ i.e. "not" (mā) ﴿تَتَّبِعُونَ﴾ in that ﴿إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ﴾ i.e. "not" (mā) ﴿أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا تَخْرُصُونَ﴾ lie in it.

celaleyn:149-149.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ if you have no argument, ﴿فَلِلَّهِ الْحُجَّةُ الْبَالِغَةُ﴾ the complete [argument]. ﴿فَلَوْ شَاءَ﴾ your guidance, ﴿لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾

celaleyn:150-150.t: ﴿قُلْ هَلُمَّ﴾ bring ﴿شُهَدَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ يَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَذَا﴾ which you have forbidden. ﴿فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَلَا تَشْهَدْ مَعَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ وَهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ﴾ associate partners.

celaleyn:151-151.t: ﴿قُلْ تَعَالَوْا أَتْلُ﴾ I will recite ﴿مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَ﴾ n [i.e. أَنْ], explicative (mufassira): ﴿لَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا وَ﴾ be good ﴿بِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ﴾ by burying them alive ﴿مِنْ﴾ because of ﴿إِمْلَاقٍ﴾ poverty that you fear; ﴿نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الْفَوَاحِشَ﴾ the major sins, such as fornication, ﴿مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ﴾ i.e. their open and their secret [forms], ﴿وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ such as retaliation (qawad), the prescribed punishment for apostasy, and the stoning of the muḥṣan. ﴿ذَلِكُمْ﴾ what has been mentioned ﴿وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ reflect.

celaleyn:152-152.t: ﴿وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي﴾ i.e. with the manner that ﴿هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾ which is whatever is for its good, ﴿حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ﴾ by reaching puberty. ﴿وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ﴾ with justice and without giving short measure. ﴿لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا﴾ its capacity in that; so if one errs in measuring or weighing, and Allah knows the soundness of his intention, there is no blame on him, as has come in a hadith. ﴿وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ﴾ in a judgement or otherwise, ﴿فَاعْدِلُوا﴾ by truthfulness, ﴿وَلَوْ كَانَ﴾ the one for or against whom the statement is ﴿ذَا قُرْبَى﴾ a relative. ﴿وَبِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ أَوْفُوا ذَلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ with shadda — take admonition — and with sukūn [تَذْكُرُونَ].

celaleyn:153-153.t: ﴿وَأَنَّ﴾ with fatḥa, on the assumption of an implied lām, and with kasra [وَإِنَّ] as a resumptive (istiʾnāf) statement, ﴿هَذَا﴾ which I have enjoined on you ﴿صِرَاطِي مُسْتَقِيمًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), ﴿فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ﴾ the ways that oppose it, ﴿فَتَفَرَّقَ﴾ in it one of the two tāʾs is dropped; it will turn ﴿بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾ His religion. ﴿ذَلِكُمْ وَصَّاكُمْ بِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾

celaleyn:154-154.t: ﴿ثُمَّ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Torah — and ثُمَّ is for ordering the reports — ﴿تَمَامًا﴾ of the blessing ﴿عَلَى الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ﴾ by carrying it out, ﴿وَتَفْصِيلًا﴾ a clarification ﴿لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ﴾ needed in religion, ﴿وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. the Children of Israel ﴿بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ by the resurrection ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾

celaleyn:155-155.t: ﴿وَهَذَا﴾ the Qur'an ﴿كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ مُبَارَكٌ فَاتَّبِعُوهُ﴾ O people of Mecca, by acting on what is in it, ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ disbelief, ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ﴾ We sent it down

celaleyn:156-156.t: ﴿أَنْ﴾ lest ﴿تَقُولُوا إِنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابُ عَلَى طَائِفَتَيْنِ﴾ the Jews and the Christians ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِنَا وَإِنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa), and its noun (ism) is omitted, i.e. "indeed we" ﴿كُنَّا عَنْ دِرَاسَتِهِمْ﴾ their reading ﴿لَغَافِلِينَ﴾ because we do not know it, since it is not in our language.

celaleyn:157-157.t: ﴿أَوْ تَقُولُوا لَوْ أَنَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتَابُ لَكُنَّا أَهْدَى مِنْهُمْ﴾ because of the excellence of our minds. ﴿فَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بَيِّنَةٌ﴾ a clarification ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾ for whoever follows it. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ﴾ turned away ﴿عَنْهَا سَنَجْزِي الَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ﴾ i.e. its severest ﴿بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْدِفُونَ﴾

celaleyn:158-158.t: ﴿هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ the deniers are not waiting for anything ﴿إِلَّا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾ with tāʾ and with yāʾ [يَأْتِيَهُمْ] ﴿الْمَلَائِكَةُ﴾ to take their souls, ﴿أَوْ يَأْتِيَ رَبُّكَ﴾ i.e. His command, in the sense of His punishment, ﴿أَوْ يَأْتِيَ بَعْضُ آيَاتِ رَبِّكَ﴾ i.e. His signs indicating the Hour. ﴿يَوْمَ يَأْتِي بَعْضُ آيَاتِ رَبِّكَ﴾ which is the rising of the sun from its place of setting, as in the hadith of the two Ṣaḥīḥs, ﴿لَا يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of النَّفْس, ﴿أَوْ﴾ a soul that had not ﴿كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمَانِهَا خَيْرًا﴾ obedience, i.e. its repentance will not benefit it, as in the hadith. ﴿قُلِ انْتَظِرُوا﴾ one of these things; ﴿إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ﴾ that.

celaleyn:159-159.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُمْ﴾ by differing about it, so that they took part of it and left part, ﴿وَكَانُوا شِيَعًا﴾ factions in that — and in one reading [فَارَقُوا], i.e. they abandoned their religion which they were commanded; they are the Jews and the Christians — ﴿لَسْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ﴾ i.e. so do not interfere with them; ﴿إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ He takes charge of it, ﴿ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾ in the Hereafter ﴿بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ and requites them for it. This is abrogated by the Verse of the Sword.

celaleyn:160-160.t: ﴿مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾ i.e. "there is no god but Allah", ﴿فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا﴾ i.e. the reward of ten good deeds; ﴿وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا﴾ i.e. its recompense, ﴿وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ are not deprived of anything of their recompense.

celaleyn:161-161.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنَّنِي هَدَانِي رَبِّي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ and from its position (maḥall) there is substituted (badal) ﴿دِينًا قِيَمًا﴾ upright, ﴿مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾

celaleyn:162-162.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي﴾ my worship, of Hajj and other things, ﴿وَمَحْيَايَ﴾ my life ﴿وَمَمَاتِي﴾ my death ﴿لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾

celaleyn:163-163.t: ﴿لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ﴾ in that; ﴿وَبِذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. affirming oneness (tawḥīd) ﴿أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾ of this community.

celaleyn:164-164.t: ﴿قُلْ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِي رَبًّا﴾ a god? i.e. I seek none other than Him, ﴿وَهُوَ رَبُّ﴾ the Owner of ﴿كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾ a sin ﴿إِلَّا عَلَيْهَا وَلَا تَزِرُ﴾ bear does a soul ﴿وَازِرَةٌ﴾ sinning ﴿وِزْرَ﴾ of a soul ﴿أُخْرَى ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

celaleyn:165-165.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ the plural of خَلِيفَة, i.e. you succeed one another in it, ﴿وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ﴾ in wealth, rank and other things, ﴿لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ﴾ to test you ﴿فِي مَا آتَاكُمْ﴾ He gave you, so as to bring to light the obedient among you and the disobedient. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ﴾ for whoever disobeys Him, ﴿وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ﴾ to the believers, ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ toward them.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ — which is describing with beauty — is established ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ Is what is meant informing of that, so as to believe in it, or praising [Him] with it, or both? These are possibilities, the most informative of which is the third; the Shaykh said this in Sūrat al-Kahf. ﴿الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ He singled them out for mention because they are the greatest of created things to those who look; ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ created ﴿الظُّلُمَاتِ وَالنُّورَ﴾ i.e. every darkness and light; He put it [darkness] in the plural and not it [light] because of the multitude of its causes. And this is among the proofs of His oneness. ﴿ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ despite this proof being established ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ﴾ make others equal [to Him] in worship.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ by creating your father Adam from it, ﴿ثُمَّ قَضَى أَجَلًا﴾ for you, at the end of which you die, ﴿وَأَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى﴾ fixed ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ for your resurrection; ﴿ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ﴾ O disbelievers ﴿تَمْتَرُونَ﴾ doubt the resurrection, after your knowing that He originated your creation — and whoever is able to originate is all the more able to repeat.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَهُوَ اللَّهُ﴾ the one deserving of worship ﴿فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ﴾ what you keep secret and what you speak openly among yourselves, ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ﴾ do of good and evil.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَمَا تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿مِنْ﴾ a connective (ṣila) [particle] ﴿آيَةٍ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ of the Qurʾān ﴿إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ﴾

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the Qurʾān ﴿لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنْبَاءُ﴾ the consequences of ﴿مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿أَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ on their journeys to al-Shām and elsewhere ﴿كَمْ﴾ declarative (khabariyya), in the sense of "many", ﴿أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ﴾ a nation of the past nations, ﴿مَكَّنَّاهُمْ﴾ We gave them a place ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ with strength and abundance ﴿مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّنْ﴾ give ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ — in it there is an iltifāt (shift) away from the third person — ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَا السَّمَاءَ﴾ the rain ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ مِدْرَارًا﴾ in succession, ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا الْأَنْهَارَ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ﴾ beneath their dwellings, ﴿فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ for their denying the prophets, ﴿وَأَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا آخَرِينَ﴾

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَابًا﴾ written ﴿فِي قِرْطَاسٍ﴾ parchment, as they demanded, ﴿فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ more forceful than "they saw it", because it removes doubt more completely, ﴿لَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ﴾ not ﴿هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ out of obstinacy and stubbornness.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا﴾ why has not ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ upon Muhammad ﷺ ﴿مَلَكٌ﴾ to confirm him? ﴿وَلَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا مَلَكًا﴾ as they demanded, and they did not believe, ﴿لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ with their destruction, ﴿ثُمَّ لَا يُنْظَرُونَ﴾ be given respite for repentance or excuse, as is Allah's custom with those before them, of destroying them when what they demanded came about, if they did not believe.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ﴾ i.e. the one sent down to them ﴿مَلَكًا لَجَعَلْنَاهُ﴾ i.e. the angel ﴿رَجُلًا﴾ i.e. in his form, so that they would be able to see him, since human beings have no power to see an angel; [and] if We had sent him down and made him a man, ﴿وَلَلَبَسْنَا﴾ We would have made obscure ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ مَا يَلْبِسُونَ﴾ upon themselves, by their saying, "This is nothing but a human being like you."

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ in it is consolation for the Prophet ﷺ; ﴿فَحَاقَ﴾ descended ﴿بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾ which is the punishment; so likewise it will befall whoever mocks you.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ انْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ of the messengers, of their destruction by punishment, so that they may take heed.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿قُلْ لِمَنْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلْ لِلَّهِ﴾ if they do not say it; there is no other answer. ﴿كَتَبَ﴾ decreed ﴿عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ﴾ as a bounty from Him — and in it there is gentleness in calling them to faith. ﴿لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَمَةِ﴾ to requite you for your deeds, ﴿لَا رَيْبَ﴾ no doubt ﴿فِيهِ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ by exposing them to punishment — a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is ﴿فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ the Exalted ﴿مَا سَكَنَ﴾ dwells ﴿فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ﴾ i.e. everything, so He is its Lord, Creator and Owner. ﴿وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ﴾ of what is said, ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of what is done.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا﴾ whom I worship, ﴿فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ their Originator, ﴿وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ﴾ provides ﴿وَلَا يُطْعَمُ﴾ is not provided for? No! [Translator's note: the source has a bare لَا here, apparently the answer to the question: "No, I will not take another".] ﴿قُلْ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ﴾ to Allah, of this community, ﴿وَ﴾ it was said to me: ﴿لَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ with Him.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي﴾ by worshipping another ﴿عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾ which is the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿مَنْ يُصْرَفْ﴾ with the passive form, i.e. the punishment, and with the active form, i.e. Allah [averts it], the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, ﴿عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُ﴾ the Exalted, i.e. He willed good for him. ﴿وَذَلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ﴾ the manifest salvation.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ﴾ an affliction such as illness and poverty, ﴿فَلَا كَاشِفَ﴾ remover ﴿لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ﴾ such as health and wealth, ﴿فَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ and among that is touching [you] with it, and no one other than He is able to turn it away from you. [Translator's note: the source reads مَسْكٌ, evidently for مَسُّكَ "touching you".]

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ﴾ the All-Powerful whom nothing can thwart, being exalted ﴿فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His creation, ﴿الْخَبِيرُ﴾ of their inner states as of their outer ones.

celaleyn:19-19.t: And [the following] was revealed when they said to the Prophet ﷺ: "Bring us someone who will bear witness to your prophethood, for the People of the Book have rejected you." ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿أَيُّ شَيْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَادَةً﴾ a tamyīz (specification) transferred from the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُ﴾ if they do not say it — there is no other answer — He is ﴿شَهِيدٌ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ to my truthfulness; ﴿وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنُ لِأُنْذِرَكُمْ﴾ make you fear, O people of Mecca, ﴿بِهِ وَمَنْ بَلَغَ﴾ conjoined to the pronoun of أُنْذِرَكُمْ, i.e. whomever the Qurʾān reaches, of mankind and jinn. ﴿أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً أُخْرَى﴾ an interrogative of disavowal (inkār). ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them: ﴿لَا أَشْهَدُ﴾ to that. ﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ with Him, of idols.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَعْرِفُونَهُ﴾ i.e. Muhammad, by his description in their Book, ﴿كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَاءَهُمُ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ of them, ﴿فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ in him.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا﴾ by attributing a partner to Him, ﴿أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِهِ﴾ the Qurʾān? ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ i.e. the matter (al-shaʾn) [is that] ﴿لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ by that.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَ﴾ remember ﴿يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا﴾ in rebuke: ﴿أَيْنَ شُرَكَاؤُكُمُ الَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ﴾ that they are partners of Allah?

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُنْ﴾ with tāʾ and yāʾ ﴿فِتْنَتَهُمْ﴾ in the accusative and the nominative [فِتْنَتُهُمْ], i.e. their excuse, ﴿إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا﴾ i.e. their saying: ﴿وَاللَّهِ رَبِّنَا﴾ in the genitive as a naʿt (adjective), and in the accusative as a vocative, ﴿مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ﴾ Allah the Exalted said:

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ O Muhammad, ﴿كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ by denying idolatry of themselves, ﴿وَضَلَّ﴾ has vanished ﴿عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ [it — هُ in the source] against Allah, of partners.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-making particle. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam. ﴿فِتْنَتُهُمْ﴾ its noun (ism), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) and accusative-making particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of takun: "except their saying". The clause takun is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; Allāh, the Name of Majesty, is a genitive (majrūr) noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "I swear" (أقسم), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ a badal (substitute) of Allāh, genitive, and nā is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما كُنَّا﴾ mā is negating. Kāna is an incomplete past verb, nā is its noun, and ﴿مُشْرِكِينَ﴾ is its khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ; the clause mā kunnā mushrikīn is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَذَبُوا عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb unẓur. The clause unẓur is resumptive. ﴿وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ما كانُوا﴾ ḍalla is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun mā is its fāʿil; the clause kānū is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kānū. It is also permissible to parse mā as maṣdar-forming, it and the verb after it being interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ḍalla, i.e. "their fabrication strayed from them".

daas-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; minhum is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ʿalā qulūbihim are attached if jaʿalnā means "We let down"; or they are attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if jaʿalnā is one of the verbs of transformation that take two objects, i.e. "We made coverings cast upon their hearts". ﴿أَنْ يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾ an is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-making particle; ﴿يَفْقَهُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ is its object.
The interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "so that they do not understand it" (لئلا يفقهوه). It is also said that the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to their understanding it", with a muḍāf omitted. The clause ﴿وَجَعَلْنا عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ is conjoined to the nominal clause before it, and the implied clause ﴿جعلنا فِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle [Translator's note: the source writes «أن» here, while the word in the verse is «إن»]. ﴿يَرَوْا كُلَّ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and kulla is its object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُوا بِها﴾ the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; lā is negating, with no grammatical position, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with fāʾ. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive. ﴿جاؤُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يُجادِلُونَكَ﴾ the verbal clause made up of the imperfect verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi is likewise in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ alladhīna is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of the verb before it, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the clause kafarū is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ هذا﴾ in is negating, and dhā is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ. The nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; hum is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾ is its khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿وَيَنْأَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); in is negating. ﴿يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); illā is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined, and mā is negating.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿وُقِفُوا عَلَى النَّارِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The apodosis of law is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen a tremendous thing on that day". ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا لَيْتَنا﴾ the yāʾ is for the vocative, the one addressed being omitted, or it is for drawing attention (tanbīh); layta is a particle resembling the verb, and nā is its noun. ﴿نُرَدُّ﴾ a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is "we" (naḥnu), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of layta. ﴿وَلا نُكَذِّبَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), lā is negating, nukadhdhiba is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the wāw of accompaniment, and the fāʿil is "we". ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ attached to nukadhdhiba. ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb after it is conjoined to an implied maṣdar, the implied form being: "Would that there were for us a return and a not-denying". ﴿وَنَكُونَ﴾ conjoined to nuraddu. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a preposition. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a genitive (majrūr) noun with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the incomplete verb ﴿نكن﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is «نكون»], whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we".

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿بَدا لَهُمْ ما﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the relative noun mā is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined by the conjunction bal. ﴿كانُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُخْفُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ qablu is an adverb of time, indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive by min; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) yukhfūna, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kānū. ﴿وَلَوْ رُدُّوا﴾ ruddū is a passive past verb, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive, after the resumptive wāw. The clause ﴿لَعادُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ʿādū. ﴿نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾ a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to nuhū; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكاذِبُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction which conjoins the clause wa-qālū to the clause ﴿لَعادُوا﴾ or to ﴿نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating, meaning mā, with no governing effect. ﴿هِيَ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿حَياتُنَا﴾ the khabar (predicate). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the clause in hiya illā ḥayātunā is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِمَبْعُوثِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; mabʿūthīna is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of mā; the nominal clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وَلَوْ تَرى إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of verse 27. ﴿أَلَيْسَ هذا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation; laysa is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the demonstrative is in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; al-ḥaqq is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of laysa; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of answer. ﴿وَرَبِّنا﴾ the wāw is a particle of the genitive and of oath; rabbinā is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath "we swear" (نقسم). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition): "since you have been asked and have confessed, then taste the punishment". Dhūqū is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ its object. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and mā is maṣdar-forming. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna, and the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تَكْفُرُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as its khabar; mā and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of your disbelief".

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا﴾ alladhīna is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent), and the clause kadhdhabū is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ an inceptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا حَسْرَتَنا﴾ yā is a vocative particle; ḥasrata is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf) and accusative, and nā is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلى ما فَرَّطْنا فِيها﴾ farraṭnā is a past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ḥasra: "O our regret over our neglect in it". ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); hum is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the verbal clause ﴿يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزارَهُمْ عَلى ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿ساءَ﴾ a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun explained by what follows it, and ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification), i.e. "evil is their deed as a burden they act upon", and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). It is also possible that ﴿ساءَ ما يَزِرُونَ﴾ is an inflecting verb, with mā a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; or mā is maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as fāʿil: "evil is their bearing [of burdens]"; or on the assumption of an omitted object: "their bearing [of burdens] grieves them" (ساء هم وزرهم).

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لَعِبٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلَهْوٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلَلدَّارُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the lām is for inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), al-dār is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ the khabar. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) khayr [Translator's note: the source says «متعلقان بخبر», "attached to a khabar"], and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, lā is negating, and the clause taʿqilūna is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قَدْ﴾ conveys paucity with the imperfect, but with respect to Allah, multiplicity is meant by it. ﴿نَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb that takes two objects, but it is suspended (muʿallaq) because of the lām of inception in the khabar (predicate) of inna, and for this reason its hamza is given kasra after naʿlamu. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَيَحْزُنُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, the kāf is its object, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent), and the verbal clause ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause qad naʿlamu is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ لا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ﴾ yukadhdhibūnaka is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the hāʾ is its noun; the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and accordingly the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لكِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ its noun, accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿بِآياتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it, ﴿بِآياتِ﴾, are attached (mutaʿalliq); the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of lākinna; the clause wa-lākinna al-ẓālimīna is conjoined to what precedes it by the conjunctive wāw.

daas-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and the lām occurs in the answer to the implied oath, i.e. "By Allah, verily were denied"; qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the quiescent tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of rusul; the clause kudhdhibat has no grammatical position because it occurs as the answer to the implied oath.
﴿فَصَبَرُوا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى ما كُذِّبُوا﴾ mā is maṣdar-forming, and it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by ʿalā; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَأُوذُوا﴾ likewise a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined, so it too is interpreted as a maṣdar, i.e. "they were patient over their being denied and being harmed". ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil. ﴿وَلا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِماتِ اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); lā is the lā of generic negation, which governs as inna does. ﴿مُبَدِّلَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿لِكَلِماتِ﴾ the two are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وَلَقَدْ جاءَكَ﴾ a past verb, the kāf is its object, and its fāʿil is omitted, the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنْ نَبَإِ﴾ being attached to its adjective, i.e. "some of the news of the messengers has come to you". The clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an implied oath, like the one before it.

daas-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; in is a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and its khabar (predicate) is the verbal clause ﴿كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْراضُهُمْ﴾; ʿalayka is attached to (mutaʿalliq) kabura, and the clause in kāna is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); in is conditional; istaṭaʿta is a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَنْ تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقاً﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an, and its object; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being "if you are able to seek". ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of nafaq. ﴿أَوْ سُلَّماً فِي السَّماءِ﴾ conjoined to ﴿نَفَقاً فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿فَتَأْتِيَهُمْ بِآيَةٍ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to tabtaghiya, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its object, its fāʿil is "you", and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "if you are able, then do so". ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى الْهُدى﴾ a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being "he"; the lām occurs in the answer to law, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَلا تَكُونَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition); lā is the prohibitive, jussive-making lā; takūnanna is an incomplete imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis, the nūn being a particle with no grammatical position; it is in the position of the jussive by lā.
﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar of the incomplete verb takūnanna, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition: "If you know that, then do not be among the ignorant".

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and a relative noun, its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause innamā yastajību is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْمَوْتى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; al-mawtā is a noun accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation), by an implied verb explained by what follows it; the implied clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿يَبْعَثُهُمُ﴾ is explicative (mufassira), with no grammatical position. It is also permissible that the wāw is resumptive and ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility, and the verbal clause ﴿يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate). ﴿ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause nuzzila is its object. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and āya is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of āya. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and its object is the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ قادِرٌ﴾: Allāh, the Name of Majesty, is the noun of inna, and qādir is its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلى أَنْ يُنَزِّلَ آيَةً﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an, and āya is its object; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by ʿalā, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the active participle qādir. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); lākinna is a particle resembling the verb, aktharahum is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause wa-lākinna is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَما مِنْ دَابَّةٍ﴾ a resumptive statement; mā is negating, with no governing effect; min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; dābba is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of dābba. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿طائِرٍ﴾ conjoined to dābba. ﴿يَطِيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ﴾ janāḥayhi is a noun genitive by the preposition, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the nūn is dropped because of annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to yaṭīru, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿إِلَّا أُمَمٌ﴾ illā is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); umam is the khabar (predicate) of dābba, nominative. ﴿أَمْثالُكُمْ﴾ an adjective. ﴿ما فَرَّطْنا فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, nā is its fāʿil (agent), and mā is negating, with no governing effect; the clause has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, interposed between the two conjoined clauses. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant particle; shayʾ is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) [Translator's note: so in the source («مرفوع محلا»); a substitute for the absolute object would be accusative in position]. ﴿ثُمَّ إِلى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is conjoined to the clause wa-mā min dābbatin.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; alladhīna is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿صُمٌّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَبُكْمٌ﴾ conjoined to ṣumm. ﴿فِي الظُّلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَشَأِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and given kasra to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ its fāʿil, and its object is omitted, the implied form being "whomever Allah wills to lead astray". And ﴿يُضْلِلْهُ﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is "he", and the clause has no grammatical position, not being joined with fāʾ; the clause yashaʾ is the khabar of man, and the nominal clause man yashaʾi Allāhu is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وَمَنْ يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ is conjoined, and the object of yashaʾ is likewise omitted, i.e. "and whomever He wills to guide, He places him".

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ﴾ i.e. "tell me": the hamza is for interrogation; raʾayta is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the kāf is a particle of address, and the mīm is for the plural. The two objects of raʾayta are omitted, i.e. "Have you considered your gods: will they avail you if the punishment of Allah comes to you?" … and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional, jussive-making. ﴿أَتاكُمْ﴾ a past verb, the kāf is its object, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَذابُ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ﴾ conjoined; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of in is omitted, the implied form being: "then whom will you call upon?" ﴿أَغَيْرَ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle; ghayra is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and the mīm is for the plural, and ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate), accusative with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it: "if you are truthful, then call upon your gods".

daas-irab:41-41.t:
﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾ a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ؟﴾.
﴿فَيَكْشِفُ ما تَدْعُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause yakshifu is conjoined to what precedes it; mā is a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause tadʿūna is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the object of tadʿūna is omitted, i.e. "what you call upon Him for". The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of ﴿إِنْ شاءَ﴾ is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. ﴿إن شاء فإنه يكشف ما تدعون إليه﴾ ("if He wills, He removes what you call upon Him for"), and the clause is parenthetical. ﴿وَتَنْسَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e. ﴿ما تشركونه﴾ ("what you associate [with Him]").

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, the lām occurs in the answer to the implied oath, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا إِلى أُمَمٍ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); nā is its fāʿil (agent), and its object is omitted: "We sent messengers to nations before you". And ﴿مِنْ﴾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَبْلِكَ﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as an adverb (ẓarf) of time, and the verbal clause has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath. ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُمْ بِالْبَأْساءِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; nā is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿وَالضَّرَّاءِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَتَضَرَّعُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as its khabar (predicate); the clause laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūna is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿فَلَوْلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; lawlā is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb taḍarraʿū after it. ﴿جاءَهُمْ بَأْسُنا﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause ﴿فلولا تضرعوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākin is lightened (mukhaffafa), for rectification (istidrāk). ﴿قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; al-shayṭān is its fāʿil, and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its object, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ kāna, the wāw is its noun, and the clause yaʿmalūna is its khabar (predicate); the clause kānū is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:44-44.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; lammā is adverbial. ﴿نَسُوا﴾ a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما ذُكِّرُوا﴾ mā is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ﴾ a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَتَحْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and nā is its fāʿil. ﴿أَبْوابَ﴾ its object. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ an inceptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive, attached to the apodosis akhadhnāhum.
﴿فَرِحُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to fariḥū, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَخَذْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, nā is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿إِذا﴾ is the idhā of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it is a particle. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُبْلِسُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فَقُطِعَ دابِرُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; quṭiʿa is a passive past verb, ﴿دابِرُ﴾ its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause quṭiʿa is conjoined. ﴿وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ al-ḥamd is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty with the preposition are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a badal (substitute) of Allāh, genitive like it with kasra. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural; the clause ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ "tell me": the hamza is for interrogation; raʾaytum is a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the plural. There is disagreement about the two objects of araʾaytum, just as there was disagreement about the two objects of araʾaytakum earlier. It is said that the first is omitted, "Have you considered your hearing", and that the second object is the interrogative clause "who is a god other than Allah?" Perhaps the nearer view, which needs no implied element, is to consider the verb suspended (muʿallaq) from governing because of the interrogation, and that the clause ﴿مَنْ إِلهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ stands in place of the two objects; the conjoined clauses ﴿إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ﴾ are parenthetical, the clause araʾaytum is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause of saying is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional particle. ﴿أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿وَأَبْصارَكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَخَتَمَ عَلى قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) khatama. ﴿مَنْ إِلهٌ﴾ man is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ilāh is its khabar (predicate). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the verse has «اللَّهِ»] the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ﴾ is a second adjective. ﴿انْظُرْ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُصَرِّفُ الْآياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and its fāʿil is "we"; the clause nuṣarrifu al-āyāti is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَصْدِفُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿قُلْ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ﴾ for the i'rab of this, see verse no. 40. ﴿يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and al-qawm is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); illā is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative with wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause stands in place of the two objects of araʾaytakum, or it is its second object, the first being omitted.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, mā is negating. ﴿نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, accusative with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبَشِّرِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with yāʾ. ﴿وَمُنْذِرِينَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-making conditional noun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause āmana is its khabar (predicate) according to some of them; or it is inceptive, and the two clauses of the protasis and apodosis are the khabar. ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَلا خَوْفٌ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); lā is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿خَوْفٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلا هُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَحْزَنُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾ is conjoined to the clause fa-lā khawfun, so like it, it is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; alladhīna is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its object and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, mā is maṣdar-forming, and it and the verb after it, kānū, are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the preposition, i.e. "because of their transgression"; the clause ﴿يَفْسُقُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kānū.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); lā is negating, with no governing effect, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb qul; the clause qul is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عِنْدِي خَزائِنُ اللَّهِ﴾ ʿindī is an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) khazāʾin. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ﴾ aʿlamu is an imperfect verb and its object, lā is negating, and the clause is conjoined to the nominal clause before it; the clause wa-lā aqūlu lakum is conjoined to the clause lā aqūlu before it. ﴿إِنِّي مَلَكٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَتَّبِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, its object. ﴿يُوحى إِلَيَّ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative with a ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿تَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, or conjoined.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿وَأَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِينَ﴾ andhir is an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَخافُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْ يُحْشَرُوا إِلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb laysa. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to the postponed noun of laysa, ﴿وَلِيٌّ﴾. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿شَفِيعٌ﴾ conjoined to ﴿وَلِيٌّ﴾; the clause of the incomplete verb is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾ laʿalla and its noun, and the clause yattaqūna is in the position of the nominative as its khabar; the clause laʿallahum yattaqūna is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وَلا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, given kasra to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْغَداةِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb yadʿūna. ﴿وَالْعَشِيِّ﴾ conjoined. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ﴾ the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما عَلَيْكَ﴾ mā is negating; ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) shayʾ, and likewise ﴿مِنْ حِسابِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to this omitted khabar.
﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; shayʾ is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ. Some parsed it as the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does, with shayʾ as its noun and ʿalayka its fronted khabar. ﴿وَما مِنْ حِسابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and the hāʾ is its object; likewise the incomplete imperfect verb ﴿فَتَكُونَ﴾, whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you", and its khabar is ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾. The clause mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim… is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause mā min ḥisābika is conjoined; the interpreted maṣdar from the fāʾ of causation and the verb taṭrudahum is conjoined, the implied form being: "Let there not be from you a driving away and a being among the wrongdoers".

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition and dhā is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We tried some of them with a trying that is like that trying"; the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; nā is its fāʿil (agent) and baʿḍahum its object, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِيَقُولُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl). Yaqūlū is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to fatannā. ﴿أَهؤُلاءِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِنا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ﴾ laysa is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; Allāh, the Name of Majesty, is its noun; in bi-aʿlama the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and aʿlama is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of laysa, genitive with fatḥa instead of kasra, being a diptote because it is descriptive and on the pattern afʿal. ﴿بِالشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) aʿlam. The clause ﴿أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial and conditional, non-jussive. ﴿جاءَكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, the kāf is its object, and the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآياتِنا﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the clause is the answer to idhā, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى نَفْسِهِ﴾ the two are attached to kataba, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الرَّحْمَةَ﴾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوءاً﴾ is its khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive-making conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَمِلَ.. سُوءاً﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مَنْ﴾, according to some of them. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil, and likewise ﴿بِجَهالَةٍ﴾: the two are also attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ تابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, conjoined to āmana [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is «عَمِلَ»]; and like it is the verb ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ﴾, conjoined, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun. ﴿فَأَنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of man; anna is a particle resembling the verb, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar. Anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then his outcome is Allah's forgiveness and His mercy".

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative dhā is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "We detail the signs with a clear detailing, like that detailing". ﴿نُفَصِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the fāʿil (agent) is "we", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl); tastabīna is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of cause; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied an and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to an implied preposition and genitive noun before them, attached to ﴿بنفصل﴾, the implied form being: "We detail the signs so that the truth may become clear". ﴿وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ tastabīna is an imperfect verb accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause. ﴿سَبِيلُ﴾ the fāʿil. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿نُهِيتُ﴾ a passive past verb, the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿أَنْ أَعْبُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb accusative by an; an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by an implied (muqaddar) preposition, i.e. "I have been forbidden from worshipping", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb nuhītu. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿لا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْواءَكُمْ﴾ the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ is its fāʿil, and qad is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of answer and requital, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿أَنَا﴾ a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is conjoined. It is also possible to parse ﴿ما﴾ as the Ḥijāzī mā, which governs as laysa does, with ﴿أَنَا﴾ as its noun and the preposition and its genitive noun attached to its khabar.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a noun genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position [of the genitive] by annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿بَيِّنَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of circumstance. ﴿ما عِنْدِي﴾ mā is negating; ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time [Translator's note: so in the source; ʿinda is normally classed as an adverb of place], accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿ما تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar is the adverb ʿindī. The verbal clause tastaʿjilūna is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِ﴾ negating, meaning mā. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ, nominative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); huwa is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾ the khabar. ﴿الْفاصِلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time [Translator's note: so in the source; ʿinda is normally classed as an adverb of place], accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of anna [Translator's note: the source skips «أَنَّ» of the verse («لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي») in its quoted words]. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna [Translator's note: so in the source («اسم إن»); the particle in the verse is «أَنَّ»]. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb: "if their hastening were established…"; the clause law and what follows it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي﴾ a passive imperfect verb [Translator's note: so in the source; «قُضِيَ» is a past verb] and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb of place, accusative with a fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; Allāh, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بِالظَّالِمِينَ﴾ are attached to it; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَعِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَفاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source, which labels the pair this way; mafātiḥu is the postponed mubtadaʾ just mentioned, and al-ghaybi is the muḍāf ilayhi], and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the hāʾ is its object, and lā is negating. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the verb yaʿlamuhā, or it is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما فِي الْبَرِّ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿مِنْ وَرَقَةٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; waraqa is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position because it is the fāʿil of ﴿تَسْقُطُ﴾. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿يَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the clause is a ḥāl of waraqa; this is allowed because it is preceded by a negation. ﴿وَلا حَبَّةٍ﴾ conjoined, and lā is negating. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ḥabba. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا رَطْبٍ﴾ conjoined to ḥabba. ﴿وَلا يابِسٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) of His words ﴿إِلَّا يَعْلَمُها﴾. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate). ﴿يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the mīm is for the plural, and the fāʿil (agent) refers back to the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object;
