﴿وما على الذين يتقون من حسابهم من شيء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the sentence is conjoined; or the wāw is resumptive and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is negative; على الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause يتقون is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; من حسابهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and شيء is genitive in form by من and nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولكن ذكرى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is lightened and inoperative (muhmala); ذكرى is accusative as a maṣdar (i.e. absolute object) by a concealed verb, i.e. "but they remind them with a reminding"; or nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is a reminder"; or it is a mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, i.e. "but upon them is a reminding".
﴿لعلهم يتقون﴾: لعلّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يتقون its khabar; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿وذر الذين اتخذوا دينهم لعبا ولهوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ذر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; دينهم is the first object of اتخذوا, لعبًا the second object, and لهوًا is conjoined to it; or اتخذوا means "acquired", so it is transitive to one object, ﴿لعبًا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and ﴿لهوًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لعبا﴾.
﴿وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the clause is conjoined, and it is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi, a fāʿil and a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وذكر به أن تبسل نفس بما كسبت ليس لها من دون الله ولي ولا شفيع﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ذكر is an imperative verb; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذكر; ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, i.e. "for fear that it be surrendered to punishment and perdition"; the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما كسبت﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تبسل﴾; the clause of ليس with what is in its scope is an adjective of نفس, or resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ولي is the noun of ليس, and شفيع is conjoined to ولي.
﴿وإن تعدل كل عدل لا يؤخذ منها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تعدل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كل عدل is accusative as a maṣdar (i.e. absolute object); لا is negative; يؤخذ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); منها is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يؤخذ. It is not permissible for the deputy agent to be a pronoun referring to the ransom (al-ʿadl), because it is not an object of تعدل; otherwise the implied form of the speech would be "and if it offered every ransom with…" (وإن تعدل بكل عدل), since تعدل reaches its object through the bāʾ.
﴿أولئك الذين أبسلوا بما كسبوا﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذين its khabar; the clause ﴿أبسلوا﴾ is the ṣila with no grammatical position; بما كسبوا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أبسلوا﴾; and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e. "because of their earning".
﴿لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب أليم﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; شراب is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لهم شراب﴾ is a second khabar, or a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position; من حميم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of شراب; عذاب is conjoined to شراب, and أليم is a naʿt.
﴿بما كانوا يكفرون﴾: ما is maṣdariyya; كانوا is an incomplete past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; the wāw is the noun (ism) of كان]; ﴿ما كانوا﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "[it] has been prepared for them", so it serves as an explanation of أبسلوا; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿يكفرون﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قل أندعو من دون الله ما لا ينفعنا ولا يضرنا﴾: قل: an imperative verb, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿قل﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿أندعو﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; ندعو is an imperfect verb, and the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ندعو; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of ندعو; the clause ﴿لا ينفعنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause ولا يضرنا conjoined to it.
﴿ونرد على أعقابنا بعد إذ هدانا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نرد is an imperfect verb conjoined to ندعو, falling under the ruling of denial and negation, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); على أعقابنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "returning to polytheism after Allah rescued us from it"; بعد is an adverb attached to ﴿نرد﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿هدانا الله﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and هدانا الله is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil.
﴿كالذي استهوته الشياطين في الأرض حيران﴾: ﴿كالذي﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the latent deputy agent of ﴿نُرَد﴾, i.e. "we are turned back resembling the one whom the devils have enticed"; ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿استهوته الشياطين﴾ is the ṣila with no grammatical position; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استهوته; and ﴿حيران﴾ is a ḥāl from the object of استهوته.
﴿له أصحاب يدعونه إلى الهدى ائتنا﴾: ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿أصحاب﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun of حيران, or resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يدعونه﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أصحاب; ﴿إلى الهدى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يدعونه; ﴿ائتنا﴾ is an imperative verb, and نا is its object; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted speech, i.e. "they say: come to us", and the clause of saying is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿قل إن هدى الله هو الهدى﴾: the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and هدى is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ, and الهدى its khabar; the nominal sentence is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ; and the clause of ﴿إن﴾ with what is in its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿وأمرنا لنسلم لرب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أمرنا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the deputy agent; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن هدى الله هو الهدى﴾, arranged within the scope of the speech. ﴿لنسلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no wāw in ﴿لنسلم﴾]; the lām is for cause (taʿlīl), so it gives the reason for the command, the implied form being "we were commanded with what we were commanded for the sake of submitting"; نسلم is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām, and أن with the verb forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the lām, the lām and its genitive being attached to ﴿أُمرنا﴾. It has been said: the lām in ﴿لنسلم﴾ is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and the verb after it is accusative by an implied ﴿أن﴾ after the lām, the implied form being "and we were commanded to submit" (وأُمرنا أن نُسلم), on the assumption of the genitive bāʾ, i.e. "with [the command] that we submit" (بأن نُسلم). ﴿لرب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نسلم﴾, and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وأن أقيموا الصلاة واتقوه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أن﴾ with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "and we were commanded with [the command]: establish the prayer"; the conjoined clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) by the speech, coordinated with His words: إن هدى الله هو الهدى, i.e. "say these two things"; or it is coordinated with ﴿لنسلم﴾, the implied form being "we were commanded such-and-such for submission and so that we establish the prayer"; أقيموا is an imperative verb, الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and اتقوه is conjoined to أقيموا.
﴿وهو الذي إليه تحشرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي its khabar (predicate); the clause تحشرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي with no grammatical position; and إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحشرون.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وهو الذي خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي its khabar (predicate); the clause خلق السماوات والأرض is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; and بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in truth and earnest, not jesting nor playing".
﴿ويوم يقول كن فيكون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause يقول is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; كن is a complete (tāmm), not incomplete, imperative verb, so it is content with its nominative; the fāʿil (agent) of كن is a pronoun; the fāʾ is a conjunction; and يكون is a complete imperfect verb conjoined to كن.
﴿قوله الحق﴾: a mubtadaʾ and a khabar, and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وله الملك يوم ينفخ في الصور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الملك is the postponed mubtadaʾ; يوم is an adverb of time attached to something omitted, a badal (substitute) of the first adverb in His words ﴿يوم يقول﴾; the clause ينفخ is in the position of genitive by annexation; and في الصور is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ينفخ.
﴿عالم الغيب والشهادة﴾: عالم is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the wāw is a conjunction, and الشهادة is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿وهو الحكيم الخبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; هو is a detached pronoun, the mubtadaʾ; الحكيم الخبير are two khabars; and the sentence is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿وإذ قال إبراهيم لأبيه آزر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿اذكر﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿قل أندعو﴾, i.e. "and remember to Quraysh — after you have denounced to them the worship of what neither benefits nor harms — the time when Ibrāhīm, whose religion they claim to follow, spoke"; the clause ﴿قال إبراهيم﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation; لأبيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال; and آزر is a badal (substitute) of أبيه.
﴿أتتخذ أصناما آلهة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); أصنامًا is the first object of تتخذ, and آلهة the second object.
﴿إني أراك وقومك في ضلال مبين﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أراك its khabar (predicate); the sentence gives the reason for the denial; قومك: conjoined to the kāf, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); في ضلال is a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the second object if the seeing is mental (qalbiyya), or a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) if the seeing is visual; and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿وكذلك نري إبراهيم ملكوت السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive, or parenthetical. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "with a showing like that We show Ibrāhīm"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; إبراهيم is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ملكوت السماوات والأرض is the second object; the clause ﴿وكذلك نري إبراهيم ...﴾ is conjoined, or the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive, or parenthetical between His words ﴿وإذ قال﴾ and the reasoning to that in His words ﴿فلما جن عليه الليل﴾.
﴿وليكون من الموقنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and what it conjoins is omitted, i.e. "and We did that so that he might be…"; so the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); يكون is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām of cause, and أن with what follows it forms an interpreted maṣdar, genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted conjoined [clause]; the noun of يكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and من الموقنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿فلما جن عليه الليل رأى كوكبا قال هذا ربي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the sentence is conjoined to the clause ﴿قال إبراهيم لأبيه﴾; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); جن is a past verb; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جن; الليل is the fāʿil (agent); the clause جن is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, or has no grammatical position on the second [view]; the clause ﴿رأى كوكبًا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿قال هذا ربي﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿هذا ربي﴾ is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فلما أفل قال لا أحب الآفلين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; the clause أفل is in the position of genitive by annexation, or has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause لا أحب الآفلين is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فلما رأى القمر بازغا قال هذا ربي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); رأى القمر is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بازغًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿ربي﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿قال هذا ربي﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فلما أفل قال لئن لم يهدني ربي لأكونن من القوم الضالين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; the clause أفل is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, or has no grammatical position. ﴿لئن﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يهدني is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ربي﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the lām is [that of] the answer to the oath, and the clause أكوننّ is the answer to the oath with no grammatical position; من القوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of أكونن; and الضالين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿فلما رأى الشمس بازغة قال هذا ربي هذا أكبر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); رأى الشمس is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بازغة is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿ربي﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿هذا أكبر﴾ is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the object of the speech; and the clause ﴿قال هذا ربي﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فلما أفلت قال يا قوم إني بريء مما تشركون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; the clause أفلت is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, or has no grammatical position; قال is a past verb; يا is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and بريء its khabar; the vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بريء﴾; ما is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), i.e. "free of your associating", or relative, i.e. "of that which you associate with Allah in His worship", the referring pronoun having been omitted; and the clause ﴿قال يا قوم...﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿إني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السماوات والأرض حنيفا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause وجهت its khabar (predicate); وجهي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للذي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) وجهت; the clause ﴿فطر السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; السماوات is the mafʿūl bihi, and الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; and حنيفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the tāʾ in وجهت.
﴿وما أنا من المشركين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative that acts like ليس, ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of ما; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-governing negative, ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وحاجه قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; حاجه is a past verb, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and قومه is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿قال أتحاجوني﴾: قال is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; and تحاجوني [is read] with a doubled nūn, by assimilation of the nūn of the nominative into the nūn of protection (wiqāya).
﴿في الله﴾: في is a preposition, and the name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحاجوني.
﴿وقد هدان﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); ﴿هدان﴾ is a past verb, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ, omitted in writing, is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the yāʾ in أتحاجوني, i.e. "do you dispute with me about Allah while He has guided me?" ﴿ولا أخاف ما تشركون به إلا أن يشاء ربي شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction, so it follows the clause ﴿وقد هدان﴾ in being accusative as a ḥāl; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi, and the pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers to ﴿ما﴾, i.e. "I do not fear that which you associate with Allah"; إلا is a particle of exception; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يشاء﴾ is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil), because it is of the same kind as the first, the thing excepted from being time, i.e. "except at the time my Lord wills something to be feared"; or the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), and ﴿إلا﴾ means "but", the interpreted maṣdar being a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "but my Lord's will, I fear it"; and شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وسع ربي كل شيء علما﴾: the clause gives the reason for the exception and has no grammatical position; وسع ربي is a verb and its fāʿil; كل شيء is the mafʿūl bihi; and علمًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil, the implied form being "my Lord's knowledge encompasses everything".
﴿أفلا تتذكرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is negative; and تتذكرون is conjoined to something omitted, i.e. "do you turn away from considering that your gods are lifeless objects that neither harm nor benefit, so that you do not remember that they are of this status?"

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وكيف أخاف ما أشركتم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the sentence after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); أخاف is an imperfect verb; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أشركتم is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما أشركتم﴾ is the object of أخاف.
﴿ولا تخافون أنكم أشركتم بالله ما لم ينزل به عليكم سلطانا﴾: ﴿ولا تخافون﴾ is conjoined to أخاف; or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "how should I fear that which you associate with Him, and your associating, while you yourselves are not afraid?"; أنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and the clause أشركتم بالله its khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi of أشركتم; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينزل; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and سلطانًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأي الفريقين أحق بالأمن إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted condition); أي is an interrogative particle, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أحق its khabar; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause تعلمون its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e. "then tell me which of the two parties is more deserving of being followed" [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah reads بالأمن, "of security"].

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿الذين آمنوا﴾: الذين is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or a mubtadaʾ, on the basis that the speech is from Allah the Exalted; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين with no grammatical position.
﴿ولم يلبسوا إيمانهم بظلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يلبسوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, conjoined to the ṣila; and بظلم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يلبسوا.
﴿أولئك لهم الأمن وهم مهتدون﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الأمن is a second, postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal sentence is the khabar of the demonstrative; the demonstrative clause with what is in its scope is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the object of an omitted speech on the first view, or nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of الذين on the second view; the wāw is a conjunction, هم is a mubtadaʾ and مهتدون its khabar; and the sentence is conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t:
﴿قل لا أجد في ما أوحي إلي محرما على طاعم يطعمه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿لا أجد﴾ is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); ﴿في ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أجد); the clause ﴿أوحي إليَّ﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (إليّ) is a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (أوحي); (محرمًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (أجد), i.e. "anything forbidden"; (على طاعم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (محرّم); and the clause ﴿يطعمه﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of (طاعم).
﴿إلا أن يكون ميتة أو دما مسفوحا أو لحم خنزير﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (أن يكون) is an accusative excepted [term]; (ميتة) is the khabar (predicate) of (يكون). Its noun is latent, referring to His saying ﴿محرمًا﴾; the clause of exception is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (دمًا) is coordinated (mansūq) with (ميتة); (مسفوحًا) is an adjective (ṣifa), i.e. "flowing", like the blood in the veins, not like the liver and the spleen; and (أو لحم خنزير) is likewise conjoined by coordination (ʿaṭf nasaq).
﴿فإنه رجس أو فسقا أهل لغير الله به﴾: the fāʾ is for causation (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle; the hāʾ is its noun; (رجس) is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; (فسقًا) is conjoined by coordination (ʿaṭf nasaq) to (لحم خنزير); the clause (أهل) is an adjective (ṣifa); (أهل) is a past verb; (لغير الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أهل); and the clause ﴿فإنه رجس﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (من) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اضطر) is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then there is no blame on him". (غير باغ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and (لا عاد) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (باغ).
﴿فإن ربك غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle; (ربك) is its noun; (غفور) is a first khabar (predicate) and (رحيم) a second khabar; the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:146-146.t:
﴿وعلى الذين هادوا حرمنا كل ذي ظفر﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (على الذين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرمنا); (هادوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (حرمنا) is likewise a verb and its fāʿil; (كل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ذي) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (ظفر) is genitive by the annexation of ﴿ذي﴾ to it.
﴿ومن البقر والغنم حرمنا عليهم شحومهما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (من البقر) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حرمنا); (الغنم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (البقر); (عليهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حرمنا); and (شحومها) [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has (شحومهما)] is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا ما حملت ظهورهما أو الحوايا﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the excepted in a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil) from (الشحوم); the clause of exception is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause ﴿حملت﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and (الحوايا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ظهورهما).
﴿أو ما اختلط بعظم﴾: (أو) is a conjunction; (ما) is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ظهورهما); (اختلط) is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (it); and (بعظم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اختلط).
﴿ذلك جزيناهم ببغيهم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. (ذلك): the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿جزيناهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the linking pronoun is omitted, the implied form being "We recompensed them with it" (جزيناهم به). (ببغيهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جزيناهم﴾.
﴿وإنا لصادقون﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (صادقون) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the position of the accusative.

muyesser-irab:147-147.t:
﴿فإن كذبوك فقل ربكم ذو رحمة واسعة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (كذبوك) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قل) is an imperative verb; (ربكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (ذو رحمة) is the khabar (predicate); (واسعة) is an adjective (ṣifa) of (رحمة); the clause is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); and the clause of saying with what lies within its scope is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ولا يرد بأسه عن القوم المجرمين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the nominal clause, falling within the scope of the saying; (يرد) is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); (بأسه) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (عن القوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يرد); and (المجرمين) is an adjective (naʿt) of (القوم).

muyesser-irab:148-148.t:
﴿سيقول الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما أشركنا ولا آباؤنا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of the future; (يقول) is an imperfect verb; (الذين) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (أشركوا) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause ﴿لو شاء الله﴾ is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (لو) is conditional; (شاء الله) is a verb and its fāʿil, and the object of the willing is omitted, i.e. "had He willed our not associating"; and (لا آباؤنا) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun in (أشركنا), the conjoining being permissible because of the presence of ﴿لا﴾.
﴿ولا حرمنا من شيء﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ما أشركنا﴾; and (من) is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), on the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governing element, i.e. "with a denial like that denial, those before them denied"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿كذب﴾ is a past verb; ﴿الذين﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلهم﴾ are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿حتى ذاقوا بأسنا﴾: (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (ذاقوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and (بأسنا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قل هل عندكم من علم فتخرجوه لنا﴾: (قل) is an imperative verb; (هل) is an interrogative particle; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (من) is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), on the mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; and the clause is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying). The fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تخرجوه) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an "an" implied (muḍmara) after it; "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "do you have any knowledge, and so a bringing of it out to us?"; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (لنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرجوه).
﴿إن تتبعون إلا الظن﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is negating; (تتبعون) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (الظن) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإن أنتم إلا تخرصون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إن) is negating; (أنتم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause ﴿تخرصون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (أنتم).

muyesser-irab:149-149.t:
﴿قل فلله الحجة البالغة﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, because it discloses an implied condition, i.e. "say: if you have no proof, then to Allah belongs the conclusive proof"; (لله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (الحجة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (البالغة) is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause is maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying).
﴿فلو شاء لهداكم أجمعين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لو) is conditional; (شاء) is a verb with a latent fāʿil (agent), and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. "your guidance"; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو); (هداكم) is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and (أجمعين) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun.

muyesser-irab:150-150.t:
﴿قل هلم شهداءكم الذين يشهدون أن الله حرم هذا﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (قل) is an imperative verb; (هلم) is a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr); (شهداءكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause (يشهدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أن الله﴾: (أن) is an abrogating particle and the Divine Name is its noun; "anna" and its noun are in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); and the clause (حرم هذا) is the khabar (predicate) of (أن).
﴿فإن شهدوا فلا تشهد معهم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (إن) is conditional; (شهدوا) is a past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is prohibitive; (تشهد) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and (معهم) is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تشهد).
﴿ولا تتبع أهواء الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تتبع) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (أهواء) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); (بآياتنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذبوا); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة وهم بربهم يعدلون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (الذين) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (بالآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون); the wāw is a conjunction; (هم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يعدلون) is its khabar (predicate); and (بربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعدلون).

muyesser-irab:151-151.t:
﴿قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم ربكم عليكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause (تعالوا) is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of the saying); (تعالوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أتل) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), or the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (حرم عليكم) has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "that which He forbade". Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. "I will recite your Lord's forbidding", and ﴿ما حرم﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) occupying the place of the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ربكم﴾ is the fāʿil of (حرم), and (عليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرم﴾ or to ﴿أتل﴾.
﴿ألا تشركوا به شيئا وبالوالدين إحسانا﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya); (لا) is prohibitive; (تشركوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and it with what lies within its scope is a badal (substitute) of ﴿ما حرم﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تشركوا﴾. The clause ﴿لا تشركوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it has the sense of the maṣdar (verbal noun); (بالوالدين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted verb of the maṣdar, i.e. "do good to the parents" (أحسنوا بالوالدين); and (إحسانًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of the omitted verb.
﴿ولا تقتلوا أولادكم من إملاق نحن نرزقكم وإياهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقتلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (أولادكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من إملاق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقتلوا), i.e. "because of poverty", so (من) is causal; (نحن) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (نرزقكم) is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿نحن نرزقكم﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position, and it is to give the cause of the prohibition before it; and (إياهم) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun in (نرزقكم).
﴿ولا تقربوا الفواحش ما ظهر منها وما بطن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقربوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الفواحش) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of (الفواحش), and it is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl); the clause ﴿ظهر﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ظهر); and (ما بطن) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to (ما ظهر).
﴿ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقتلوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (النفس) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (التي) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa); the clause ﴿حرم الله﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (بالحق) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in ﴿تقتلوا﴾, i.e. "do not kill it except clothed in right", or attached to something omitted standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective (naʿt) of the maṣdar, i.e. "except with a killing clothed in right".
﴿ذلكم وصاكم به﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause (وصاكم) is the khabar (predicate) of (ذلكم); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وصاكم).
﴿لعلكم تعقلون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun; the clause (تعقلون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:152-152.t:
﴿ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم إلا بالتي هي أحسن حتى يبلغ أشده﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تقربوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (مال اليتيم) is its object; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بالتي): the relative noun is an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقربوا), i.e. "except in the manner which is best"; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (أحسن) its khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يبلغ) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) "an" after (حتى); "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar made genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (تقربوا); and (أشده) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأوفوا الكيل والميزان بالقسط﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf); (أوفوا الكيل) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الميزان) is conjoined to (الكيل), accusative; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of (أوفوا), i.e. "being equitable and just", or a ḥāl of the mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "complete".
﴿لا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها﴾: (لا) is negating. (نكلف): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (نفسًا): a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (وسعها): a second mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿لا نكلف...﴾ is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا قلتم فاعدلوا ولو كان ذا قربى وبعهد الله أوفوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (إذا) is conditional and adverbial; the clause (قلتم) is in the position of the genitive by iḍāfa (annexation); the fāʾ is a linking one; (اعدلوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو) is a non-jussive conditional; (كان) is a defective past verb, its noun a latent pronoun and (ذا قربى) its khabar (predicate); (بعهد الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوفوا); and (أوفوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.
﴿ذلكم وصاكم به﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause (وصاكم) is the khabar (predicate) of (ذلكم); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وصاكم).
﴿لعلكم تذكرون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun; the clause (تذكرون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:153-153.t:
﴿وأن هذا صراطي مستقيما فاتبعوه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; (أن) is an abrogating particle; (هذا) is its noun; (صراطي) is its khabar (predicate); (مستقيمًا) is a corroborative ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida) of (صراطي), its governing element being the sense of pointing; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); (اتبعوه) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تتبعوا السبل فتفرق بكم عن سبيله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لا) is prohibitive; (تتبعوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (السبل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فتفرق﴾: the fāʾ is the causative fāʾ (al-sababiyya), and (تفرق) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an "an" implied (muḍmara) after the fāʾ in the answer to the prohibition; "an" and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no following of the paths from you, and then a scattering". (بكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تفرق); and (عن سبيله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "far removed from His path".
﴿ذلكم وصاكم به﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (ذلكم) is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (وصاكم) is the khabar (predicate) of (ذلكم); and (به) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وصاكم).
﴿لعلكم تتقون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle; the kāf is its noun; the clause (تتقون) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب﴾: (ثم) is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; (آتينا موسى الكتاب) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects.
﴿تماما﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of completing the favour and honour"; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الكتاب), i.e. "in the state of its being complete"; or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the sense of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "We gave it to him with a complete giving, without deficiency"; or a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent), i.e. "completing".
﴿على الذي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمامًا﴾, i.e. "upon the one who excelled in carrying it out"; and the clause ﴿أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position.
﴿وتفصيلا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تمامًا﴾.
﴿لكل شيء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تفصيلًا﴾.
﴿وهدى ورحمة لعلهم بلقاء ربهم يؤمنون﴾: (هدى) and (رحمة) are conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تمامًا﴾ and ﴿تفصيلًا﴾; (لعل) is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (بلقاء ربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; and the clause (يؤمنون) is the khabar (predicate) of (لعل).

nahhas-irab:26-26.t: Al-Ḥasan read وهم ينهون عنه وينون عنه: he cast the vowel of the hamza onto the nūn and dropped the hamza.

nahhas-irab:27-27.t:
In Arabic it is permissible to say إذ أقفوا على النّار, like أُقِّتَتْ [al-Mursalāt: 11]. The people of Medina and al-Kisāʾī read يا لَيْتَنا نُرَدُّ وَلا نُكَذِّبَ بِآياتِ رَبِّنا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ with all of it in the nominative (rafʿ). Abū Jaʿfar said: This is also how it is transmitted from Abū ʿAmr, and it is transmitted from him as وَلا نُكَذِّبَ بِآياتِ رَبِّنا with assimilation (idghām). The Kufans, ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar and Ibn Abī Isḥāq read يا لَيْتَنا نُرَدُّ وَلا نُكَذِّبَ in the accusative (naṣb), and وَنَكُونَ likewise. ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir read يا ليتنا نرد ولا نكذب in the nominative and وَنَكُونَ ] in the accusative. Ubayy and Ibn Masʿūd read يا ليتنا نردّ ولا نكذّب بآيات ربّنا with the fāʾ and the accusative. Abū Jaʿfar said:
The first reading, in the nominative, is on the basis that it is cut off from what precedes it; this is the view of Sībawayh. It has also been said: it is conjoined (ʿaṭf). The assimilation is good. The accusative after the wāw is on the basis that it is the answer to the wish (jawāb al-tamannī), and likewise with the fāʾ. The nominative of the first verb in the reading of Ibn ʿĀmir is on the basis of its being cut off from what precedes it, or of conjunction, and «ونكون» is made the answer.

nahhas-irab:28-28.t: بَلْ بَدا لَهُمْ ما كانُوا يُخْفُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ: there are two views on its meaning. One is that it refers to the hypocrites, because the term "unbelief" includes them, so the pronoun refers back to part of what was mentioned; this is eloquent Arabic usage. The other view is that whenever the Prophet ﷺ admonished the unbelievers they were afraid, and they hid that fear so that the weak among them would not become aware of it; then that was made manifest on the Day of Resurrection. Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb read وَلَوْ رُدُّوا with a kasra on the rāʾ, because the original form is رددوا, and the kasra of the dāl was shifted onto the rāʾ, as one says قيل and بيع. But there is a difference between them, because in قيل the vowel was shifted only because it is a weak verb (muʿtall), and yāʾ and wāw are not governed like other letters, since they so frequently change.

nahhas-irab:29-29.t: وَقالُوا إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَياتُنَا الدُّنْيا: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). وَما نَحْنُ: the noun of mā. نَحْنُ: the predicate. [Translator's note: so in the source; one would expect نحن to be the noun of mā and بمبعوثين its predicate.]

nahhas-irab:31-31.t:
قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِلِقاءِ اللَّهِ, that is: they have lost their deeds and their reward. حَتَّى إِذا جاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); according to Sībawayh it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl, as you say:
قتلته صبرا ("I killed him in confinement"), and he recited: [al-Ṭawīl] 131-
فلأيا بلأي ما حملنا وليدنا ... على ظهر محبوك ظماء مفاصله
(Only with great difficulty did we mount our lad on the back of a firm-bodied horse with lean joints.)
Sībawayh does not permit analogy to be drawn from it: one does not say جاء فلان سرعة. وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزارَهُمْ, that is, their sins; He made them, because of their heaviness, like a heavy load carried on the back. It has also been said: it means the punishments of sins, because punishment is called wizr. أَلا ساءَ ما يَزِرُونَ, that is, what they carry.

nahhas-irab:32-32.t: وَمَا الْحَياةُ الدُّنْيا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); that is, those who desire the life of this world: it has no lasting outcome, so it is like amusement and play. وَلَلدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ: subject and predicate. Ibn ʿĀmir read ولدار الآخرة, lightened and in the genitive. And the abode of the Hereafter is better because it endures. لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ, that is, who guard against disobedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ that the matter is so, and so renounce this world?

nahhas-irab:33-33.t: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ الَّذِي يَقُولُونَ: «إنّ» takes a kasra because of the entry of the lām. فَإِنَّهُمْ لا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ: we have already discussed it. It is reported that Muḥammad ibn Yazīd said: يكذبونك and يكذّبونك have one meaning. He said: لا يكذبونك may mean "they do not find you bringing falsehood", as you say أبخلت الرجل ("I found the man stingy"). Someone else said: the meaning of لا يكذّبونك is "they do not give you the lie with any proof or demonstration", and this is indicated by وَلكِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ.

nahhas-irab:34-34.t:
وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ: on the feminine of the group. رُسُلٌ: the noun of the verb whose agent is not named (nāʾib fāʿil, deputy agent); if you wish you may drop the ḍamma and say رسل, because the ḍamma is heavy. فَصَبَرُوا عَلى ما كُذِّبُوا, that is: so be patient as they were patient.
وَأُوذُوا حَتَّى أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا, that is: so what you have been promised will come to you. وَلا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِماتِ اللَّهِ explains this; that is, what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has promised, no one is able to avert.

nahhas-irab:35-35.t: وَإِنْ كانَ: a condition. كَبُرَ: a past verb, and it is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقاً فِي الْأَرْضِ: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). أَوْ سُلَّماً فِي السَّماءِ: conjoined to it, that is, a means of reaching the sky. This is a figurative representation, because the ladder by which one climbs is a means to the place. What al-Farrāʾ reported about the feminine gender of سلّم is not known. فَتَأْتِيَهُمْ بِآيَةٍ: conjoined. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded the Prophet ﷺ not to grieve intensely over them since they would not believe, just as he was not able to do this. فَلا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ: of those whose grief became intense and who lamented until it drove them to extreme despair and to what is not permitted.

nahhas-irab:36-36.t: إِنَّما يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ, that is, they listen with the listening of attention, understanding and desire for the truth. وَالْمَوْتى يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ: these are the unbelievers, and they are like the dead in that they neither accept nor give ear to any proof.

nahhas-irab:37-37.t: وَقالُوا لَوْلا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ: this was obstinacy on their part after the proofs had become manifest and the argument had been established by the Qurʾan, whose like they were unable to produce even a single sura of, because of the description and knowledge of the unseen it contains. وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sends down only those signs in which there is benefit for His servants.

nahhas-irab:38-38.t: وَما مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلا طائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ: conjoined to the wording (ʿaṭf ʿalā al-lafẓ). Al-Ḥasan and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Isḥāq read وَلا طائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ, making it conjoined to the position (ʿalā al-mawḍiʿ), the implied form being: وما دابة ولا طائر يطير بجناحيه. [Translator's note: the vowelling of this variant as printed is identical to the main reading; the variant intended is presumably the nominative طائرٌ.] إِلَّا أُمَمٌ أَمْثالُكُمْ, that is, they are communities like you in that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created them, guaranteed their provision and dealt justly with them, so you should not wrong them nor go beyond what you have been commanded concerning them. دابّة applies to everything that creeps. ما فَرَّطْنا فِي الْكِتابِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ, that is, We have left out nothing of the matter of religion without having pointed to it in the Qurʾan, either by a clear, explained indication or by a general one, such as وَما آتاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَما نَهاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا [al-Ḥashr: 7]. ثُمَّ إِلى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ: by this He indicated that the beasts will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection.

nahhas-irab:39-39.t: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). مَنْ يَشَأِ اللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ: condition and requital (sharṭ wa-mujāzāh), and likewise وَمَنْ يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ.

nahhas-irab:40-40.t:
قُلْ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ with both hamzas fully pronounced is the reading of Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim and Ḥamza. Nāfiʿ read it lightening the hamzas: he casts the vowel of the first onto what precedes it and pronounces the second "between and between" (bayna bayna). Abū ʿUbayd reported from him that he drops the hamza and substitutes an alif for it; according to the philologists this is an error attributed to him, because the yāʾ is quiescent and the alif is quiescent, and two quiescent letters do not come together. ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar and al-Kisāʾī read قل أريتكم, dropping the second hamza; this is far-fetched in Arabic and is permissible only in poetry. The Arabs say: أريتك زيدا ما شأنه ("Tell me about Zayd, what is his state?"). Al-Farrāʾ said: the kāf has the form of an accusative but the meaning of a nominative, as one says دونك زيدا, that is, "take him". Abū Isḥāq said: this is impossible; rather the kāf has no grammatical position and is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis, as one says ذاك. On this basis the Arabs say in the dual أريتكما زيدا ما شأنه, in the plural أريتكم زيدا, and to a woman أريتك زيدا ما شأنه: they leave the tāʾ singular and put the marker on the kāf. If the kāf is in the position of the accusative they say in the dual:
أريتما كما عالمين بفلان, in the plural أريتموكم عالمين بفلان, for a group of women أريتكنّ عالمات بفلان, and for a single woman أريتك عالمة بزيد. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَيَطْغى أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنى [al-ʿAlaq: 6–7], and it is of exactly this kind.

nahhas-irab:41-41.t: إِيَّاهُ: accusative governed by تدعون. فَيَكْشِفُ ما تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ: an imperfect (future) verb. وَتَنْسَوْنَ: "and you abandon", like وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنا إِلى آدَمَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَنَسِيَ [Ṭā Hā: 115]. It may also mean: you abandon, and so you are like those who forget. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aʿraj read [Translator's note: the source names no reading here; the text appears to be defective]. مَنْ إِلهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ انْظُرْ with a ḍamma on the hāʾ according to the original form, because the hāʾ is originally with ḍamma, as you say جئت معه. We have already discussed the use of the singular hāʾ.

nahhas-irab:49-49.t: Al-Kisāʾī said: one says بغتهم الأمر يبغتهم بغتا وبغتة when it comes upon them suddenly. Al-Ḥasan and al-Aʿmash read الْعَذابُ بِما with assimilation, and so it is transmitted from Abū ʿAmr with assimilation. Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb and al-Aʿmash read بِما كانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ with a kasra on the sīn, and it is a well-known dialect form.

nahhas-irab:52-52.t: وَلا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ: jussive (majzūm) by the prohibition; the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the ḍamma, and the dāl takes a kasra because two quiescent letters meet. يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَداةِ: غداة is indefinite and was made definite with alif and lām; it is written with a wāw just as الصلاة is written with a wāw. Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir and Mālik ibn Dīnār read بِالْغَداةِ [Translator's note: the variant intended is بالغُدوة, which the following explanation discusses; the printed text repeats the main reading]. The rule for غدوة is that it is definite, but it may be made indefinite just as proper nouns are made indefinite, and when it is made indefinite alif and lām enter it to make it definite. عشيّ and عشيّة are indefinite only. ما عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسابِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ: the first (من) is partitive and the second is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis, and likewise وَما مِنْ حِسابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ. فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ: the answer to the negation. فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ: the answer to the prohibition.

nahhas-irab:53-53.t: The lām of purpose (lām kay). This is one of the difficult points. It is asked: how were they tried so that they would say this, since if it was a denial it is unbelief on their part? There are two answers to this. One is that the meaning is: We tried the rich by means of the poor, in that their standing with the Prophet ﷺ was one and the same, so that they would say by way of question, not by way of denial, أَهؤُلاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَيْنِنا. The other answer is that when they were tried by this, and its outcome led to their saying this by way of denial, it became like the saying of Him, Majestic and Mighty: فَالْتَقَطَهُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَناً [al-Qaṣaṣ: 8].

nahhas-irab:54-54.t: فَقُلْ سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ: nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and according to Sībawayh it carries the meaning of the accusative; that is why it begins with an indefinite noun. كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلى نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ, that is, He made it binding; the servants were addressed in terms of what they know, namely that whoever writes something down has made it binding on himself. It has also been said: He wrote that in the Preserved Tablet. Abū Jaʿfar said: We have already mentioned the reading of those who read (أنّه) (فأنه) with a fatḥa on both, the reading of those who put a kasra on both, and the reading of those who put a fatḥa on the first and a kasra on the second. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aʿraj read with a kasra on the first and a fatḥa on the second; so Ibn Saʿdān transmitted from him. Whoever gives both a fatḥa makes the first a badal (substitute) for الرحمة, or takes it as having an implied mubtadaʾ, that is, "it is such-and-such"; and the second, according to Sībawayh, is a repetition ], as Allah, Majestic and Mighty, said: لا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِما أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِما لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا فَلا تَحْسَبَنَّهُمْ بِمَفازَةٍ مِنَ الْعَذابِ [Āl ʿImrān: 188], and He, Majestic and Mighty, said إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هادُوا and then said afterwards إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ [al-Ḥajj: 17]. Al-Akhfash and Abū Ḥātim said: the second «أنّ» is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ, that is, "then forgiveness is his". This is wrong according to Sībawayh, for Sībawayh does not allow a sentence to begin with أنّ. But some grammarians have said the second «أنّ» may be in the position of the nominative with an implied mubtadaʾ, that is, "then what is his is that Allah is Forgiving, Merciful". Whoever puts a kasra on both makes the first the beginning of a new sentence and takes كتب in the sense of "said", and puts a kasra on the second because it comes after the fāʾ in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). Whoever puts a kasra on the first and a fatḥa on the second treats the first as we said and puts a fatḥa on the second on the basis of an implied mubtadaʾ; Abū Ḥātim rejected this reading, as it had not reached him. Whoever puts a fatḥa on the first and a kasra on the second treats the first as we mentioned for the one who gives both a fatḥa, and puts a kasra on the second as is required for it after the fāʾ; this reading is clear in Arabic.

nahhas-irab:55-56.t: وَكَذلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآياتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ: it is said: this lām is attached (mutaʿalliq) to a verb, so where is the verb to which it is attached? The Kufans say: the implied form is وكذلك نفصّل الآيات لنبيّن لكم ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين. Abū Jaʿfar said: none of this ellipsis is needed; the implied form is: وكذلك نفصّل الآيات، ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين فصّلناها. سبيل is treated as both masculine and feminine, the feminine being more common. Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb and Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif read قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذاً with a kasra on the lām, and Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ said: ضللت is the dialect of Tamīm.

nahhas-irab:57-57.t: قُلْ إِنِّي عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِهِ: the pronoun refers back to البيّنة, and it is masculine because البيان and البيّنة are one and the same. It has also been said: the implied form is "and you denied what I have brought". Abū Jaʿfar said: we have already discussed يقضي الحقّ and يَقُصُّ الْحَقَّ.

nahhas-irab:58-58.t: قُلْ لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدِي ما تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ, that is, of the punishment. لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ, that is, it would have been cut off, to the end of the verse.

nahhas-irab:59-59.t: وَعِنْدَهُ مَفاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ, which opens the knowledge of the unseen when He, Majestic and Mighty, wishes to inform a prophet or someone else of it. مفاتح is the plural of مفتح; this is the eloquent usage, and one also says مفتاح, the plural being مفاتيح. Al-Ḥasan and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Isḥāq read ولا رطب لا يابس إلّا في كتاب مّبين, conjoined to the meaning. [Translator's note: so in the source, "لا يابس" without wāw; the variant intended is presumably the nominative ولا رطبٌ ولا يابسٌ.] It is also permissible to take وَلا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُماتِ الْأَرْضِ as mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). إِلَّا فِي كِتابٍ مُبِينٍ, that is, Allah wrote it down so that the angels would take heed of it.

nahhas-irab:60-60.t: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); that is, He takes the full count of you. بِاللَّيْلِ and في الليل are the same. Abū Rajāʾ and Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif read ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضي أجلا مسمّى.

nahhas-irab:61-61.t: حَتَّى إِذا جاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ: this is the preference of al-Khalīl, and it is the reading of Nāfiʿ, lightening the second hamza. It is also permissible to lighten both and to drop one of them. تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنا: on the feminine of the group, as He said: فَلَمَّا جاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّناتِ [Ghāfir: 83]. Ḥamza read توفّاه رسلنا, treating the plural as masculine, and al-Aʿmash read يتوفّاه رسلنا, with an added yāʾ at its beginning and the masculine.

nahhas-irab:62-62.t: ثُمَّ رُدُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلاهُمُ الْحَقِّ: as a naʿt (adjective). Al-Ḥasan read الحقّ in the accusative, which may be a maṣdar (verbal noun) or in the sense of "I mean" (aʿnī). The meaning of مولاهم الحقّ is that He is their Creator, their Provider, the One who benefits them and harms them, and none is so but Allah, Majestic and Mighty. أَلا لَهُ, that is: know and say that His alone is the judgement.

nahhas-irab:63-63.t: تَدْعُونَهُ تَضَرُّعاً: a maṣdar (verbal noun); it may also be a ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being "possessed of humility". Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh transmitted from ʿĀṣim وَخُفْيَةً with a kasra on the khāʾ, and it is transmitted from al-Aʿmash وخيفة, with the yāʾ before the fāʾ; this is a far-fetched meaning, because the meaning of تضرعا is that they show abasement openly, and خفية that they conceal the like of that. The Kufans read لَئِنْ أَنْجانا, but the coherence of the passage favours the tāʾ, as the people of Medina and the people of Syria read it.

nahhas-irab:65-65.t:
أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعاً. It is transmitted from Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Madanī أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ»
with a ḍamma on the yāʾ, that is, He will cover you with punishment and envelop you in it; this is from اللُّبس with a ḍamma on the lām, while the first is from اللَّبس with a fatḥa. [Translator's note: so in the source.] It is a difficult passage, and the i'rab clarifies it. It has been said: the implied form is "or He will confuse your affair for you", one of the two objects and the preposition having been omitted, as Allah, Majestic and Mighty, said: وَإِذا كالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ [al-Muṭaffifīn: 3]. This confusion consists in some of them being let loose to fight others, or in His showing them a sign at which they split up, so that they are seen as factions. شِيَعاً is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) or as a maṣdar (verbal noun). It has also been said: the meaning of يلبسكم شيعا is that He strengthens your enemy until it mingles with you, and when it mingles with you it has clothed you in divisions. وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُمْ بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ: by war.

nahhas-irab:66-67.t:
قُلْ لَسْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ: I have not been commanded to guard you against denial and unbelief.
It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās: لِكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُسْتَقَرٌّ, that is, every report has a reality.

nahhas-irab:68-68.t: وَإِذا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي آياتِنا: the implied form is: "and when you see those who plunge into Our signs with denial, rejection and mockery". فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ, disapproving of them. حَتَّى يَخُوضُوا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَإِمَّا يُنْسِيَنَّكَ الشَّيْطانُ فَلا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ الذِّكْرى مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ: thus Allah, Majestic and Mighty, disciplined His Prophet ﷺ, because he used to sit with a group of the polytheists, admonishing them and calling them, and they would mock the Qurʾan; so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded him to turn away from it with the turning away of one who disapproves, and not to give it attention. In this there is a refutation, in the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, of those who claim that the imams, who are proofs, and their followers may mix with the transgressors and approve their opinions out of taqiyya (dissimulation). ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir read وَإِمَّا يُنْسِيَنَّكَ الشَّيْطانُ in the intensive form. [Translator's note: the intended reading is يُنَسِّيَنَّكَ with a doubled sīn; the printed vowelling is that of the main reading.]

nahhas-irab:69-69.t:
وَلكِنْ ذِكْرى: in the position of the accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun). It may also be in the position of the nominative, meaning «ولكن الذي يفعلونه ذكرى» ("but what they do is a reminder"), that is, "but upon them is a reminder". Al-Kisāʾī said:
the meaning is "but this is a reminder".

nahhas-irab:70-70.t: وَذَكِّرْ بِهِ أَنْ تُبْسَلَ: in the position of the accusative, that is, "for fear (karāhata) that it be given up to destruction". بِما كانُوا يَكْفُرُونَ: in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

nahhas-irab:71-71.t: قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَنْفَعُنا وَلا يَضُرُّنا وَنُرَدُّ عَلى أَعْقابِنا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدانَا اللَّهُ كَالَّذِي اسْتَهْوَتْهُ الشَّياطِينُ فِي الْأَرْضِ حَيْرانَ لَهُ أَصْحابٌ يَدْعُونَهُ إِلَى الْهُدَى ائْتِنا قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدى وَأُمِرْنا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ (71) قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَنْفَعُنا, that is, what does not benefit us if we call upon it. وَلا يَضُرُّنا if we abandon it. وَنُرَدُّ عَلى أَعْقابِنا, that is, we return to error after guidance. The singular of أعقاب is عقب; it is feminine and its diminutive is عقيبة. كَالَّذِي: the kāf is in the position of the accusative as the naʿt (adjective) of a maṣdar. اسْتَهْوَتْهُ الشَّياطِينُ: on the feminine of the group. Ḥamza read استهواه الشياطين, treating the plural as masculine. It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd استهواه الشيطان, and from al-Ḥasan استهوته الشياطون ]; Maḥbūb transmitted it from ʿAmr from al-Ḥasan, and it is a solecism (laḥn). حَيْرانَ: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it is a diptote because its feminine is حيرى. لَهُ أَصْحابٌ يَدْعُونَهُ إِلَى الْهُدَى ائْتِنا: when beginning with it, ائتنا [Translator's note: i.e. pronounced ītinā]; the original form has two hamzas, one of which was changed into a yāʾ so that they would not come together. وَأُمِرْنا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ: the lām of purpose (lām kay). Abū Jaʿfar said: I heard Abū al-Ḥasan ibn Kaysān say: it is the lām of the genitive; all lāms are three: the lām of the genitive, the lām of command and the lām of emphasis, and nothing falls outside them.

nahhas-irab:72-73.t:
وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ: there are three views on it. Al-Farrāʾ's position is that the meaning is "and we were commanded that we submit and that: establish prayer". The second answer is that the meaning is "and with: establish the prayer". The third is that it is conjoined to the meaning, that is, they call him to guidance and call him to: establish prayer, because the meaning of «ائتنا» is "that: come to us".
وَهُوَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and likewise وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ. وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ: there are three answers concerning it: it may be conjoined to the hāʾ in وَاتَّقُوهُ; the second is that it is conjoined to السموات; and the third is that it is in the sense of "remember". كُنْ فَيَكُونُ: there are three answers concerning it. Al-Farrāʾ said: it is said that it concerns the Trumpet specifically: «ويوم يقول للصور كن فيكون» ("and the day He says to the Trumpet 'Be', and it is"). The second answer is that the meaning is: then everything He willed comes to be, of people's death and their life. On these two answers قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ is mubtadaʾ and khabar. The third answer is that قوله is nominative as the subject of يكون and الحقّ is its naʿt (adjective). يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ: there are three answers concerning it: it may be a badal (substitute) for يوم; the second answer is that the implied form is "His word is the truth on the day the Trumpet is blown"; and the third answer is that the implied form is "and His is the dominion on the day the Trumpet is blown". عالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهادَةِ: there are three answers concerning it: it may be a naʿt of الذي, that is, "and He it is who created the heavens, the Knower of the unseen"; it may be on the basis of an implied mubtadaʾ. Al-Ḥasan, al-Aʿmash and ʿĀṣim read عالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهادَةِ [Translator's note: the variant intended is the genitive عالمِ; the printed vowelling repeats the main reading], which may be a badal for the hāʾ in (له). The third answer for the nominative is that it is construed according to the meaning, that is, the Knower of the unseen blows into it, because since the blowing into it is by the command of Allah it is attributed to Allah, Majestic and Mighty. Sībawayh recited: [al-Ṭawīl] 132-
ليبك يزيد ضارع لخصومة ... وأشعث ممّن طوّحته الطّوائح
(Let Yazīd be wept for — by one humbled in a dispute, and by a dishevelled man of those whom calamities have cast far away.)

nahhas-irab:74-74.t:
وَإِذْ قالَ إِبْراهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ آزَرَ: the scholars have discussed this. Al-Ḥasan said: his father's name was Āzar. It has been said that he had two names, Āzar and Tāraḥ. Al-Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān transmitted from his father, who said: it has reached me that it means "crooked"; he said: and it is the harshest word Ibrāhīm ﷺ said to his father. Al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: the meaning of آزر is "old man".
Abū Jaʿfar said: this may be derived from الأزر, which is the back; it is a diptote because it is on the pattern afʿal, and it would be a badal (substitute), as one says رجل أجوف, that is, "great of belly"; likewise آزر would be "great of back, crooked in it". It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās that he read وإذ قال إبراهيم لأبيه أازرا with two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second with kasra; this is the transmission of Abū Ḥātim, and he did not explain its meaning. It may be derived from الأزر, the back, its meaning being strength, and it would be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); it may also be in the sense of وزر, as one says وسادة and إسادة. In a transmission other than Abū Ḥātim's it is with two hamzas both with fatḥa, and in both transmissions تَتَّخِذُ without an alif. أَصْناماً آلِهَةً: two objects, and it carries the sense of disapproval. إِنِّي أَراكَ وَقَوْمَكَ: conjoined to the kāf.

nahhas-irab:75-75.t: Abū al-Sammāl al-ʿAdawī read وَكَذلِكَ نُرِي إِبْراهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ with a sukūn on the lām. According to Sībawayh dropping the fatḥa is not permissible because of its lightness; perhaps it is a dialect form. وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُوقِنِينَ, that is: and so that he would be one of those with certainty, We showed him.

nahhas-irab:76-76.t: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ رَأى كَوْكَباً: an object. قالَ هذا رَبِّي: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). Among the best things said about this is what is authentically reported from Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah have mercy on him, that he said concerning the words of Allah, Majestic and Mighty, نُورٌ عَلى نُورٍ [al-Nūr: 35]: "Thus is the heart of the believer: it knows Allah, Majestic and Mighty, and reasons its way to Him with its heart, and when it knows Him it increases in light upon light." Likewise Ibrāhīm ﷺ knew Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with his heart and reasoned his way to Him by His signs, and so knew that he had a Lord and Creator; and when Allah, Majestic and Mighty, made Himself known to him, his knowledge increased, and he said: أَتُحاجُّونِّي فِي اللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدانِ [al-Anʿām: 80].

nahhas-irab:78-78.t:
فَلَمَّا رَأَى الشَّمْسَ بازِغَةً: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), because this is seeing with the eye. قالَ هذا رَبِّي: al-Kisāʾī and al-Akhfash said: that is, he said "this rising one is my Lord". Others said: that is, "this light". Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān said: that is, "this figure", as al-Aʿshā said: [al-Sarīʿ] 133-
قامت تبكّيه على قبره ... من لي من بعدك يا عامر
تركتني في الدّار ذا غربة ... قد ذلّ من ليس له ناصر
(She stood weeping for him at his grave: "Who is there for me after you, O ʿĀmir? You have left me in the abode a stranger; humbled is he who has no helper.")

nahhas-irab:79-79.t: That is: I have directed my worship and my affirmation of oneness to Allah, Majestic and Mighty, alone. وَما أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ: the noun of «ما» and its predicate. When you pause you say أنا, adding the alif to show the vowel; and among the Arabs are those who say «انه».

nahhas-irab:80-80.t:
وَحاجَّهُ قَوْمُهُ قالَ أَتُحاجُّونِّي: Nāfiʿ read أتحاجّوني with a single, light nūn. It is reported that Abū ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAlāʾ said: it is a solecism (laḥn). Sībawayh permitted it and said: they found the doubling heavy; and he recited: [al-Wāfir] 134-
تراه كالثّغام يعلّ مسكا ... يسوء الفاليات إذا فليني
(You see it [i.e. grey hair] like the white thughām plant, steeped again and again in musk; it vexes the women who search it for lice when they search me.)
Abū ʿUbayda said: those who disliked the doubled form disliked it only because of the combination of two quiescent letters, namely the wāw and the nūn, so they dropped it. Abū Jaʿfar said: the right view on this is the view of Sībawayh; the combination of two quiescent letters is not objectionable when the first is a letter of prolongation and softness and the second is assimilated. وَقَدْ هَدانِ, with the yāʾ dropped because the kasra indicates it and the nūn compensates for it when you drop it; retaining it is good. وَلا أَخافُ ما تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ, that is, because it neither benefits nor harms; ما is in the position of the accusative. إِلَّا أَنْ يَشاءَ رَبِّي شَيْئاً: in the position of the accusative as an exception not of the same kind as the first (istithnāʾ laysa min al-awwal). وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْماً: specification (bayān).

nahhas-irab:81-81.t: وَكَيْفَ أَخافُ ما أَشْرَكْتُمْ: an object, and likewise وَلا تَخافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ ما لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطاناً, that is, an argument. فَأَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالْأَمْنِ: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ, that is: if you know, then whoever fears the One who benefits and harms is more entitled to security than you.

nahhas-irab:82-82.t: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ: mubtadaʾ (subject). أُولئِكَ: a second mubtadaʾ. لَهُمُ الْأَمْنُ: its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of the first. وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ: mubtadaʾ and khabar.

nahhas-irab:83-83.t: Likewise وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنا. The reading of the people of the two Sanctuaries and of Abū ʿAmr is نَرْفَعُ دَرَجاتٍ مَنْ نَشاءُ with the genitive construct (iḍāfa); the people of Kufa read نَرْفَعُ دَرَجاتٍ مَنْ نَشاءُ, the implied form being "and We raise whom We will to degrees", after which «إلى» was omitted. [Translator's note: the two readings are printed identically; the first intended is دَرَجاتِ مَن (construct), the second دَرَجاتٍ مَن (with tanwīn).]

nahhas-irab:84-84.t: وَوَهَبْنا لَهُ إِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ: two foreign names that are diptotes when definite and triptotes when indefinite. If you derive إسحاق from أسحقه الله ("Allah crushed him"), it is a triptote; likewise يعقوب, if it is a transferred (Arabic) name, is a triptote in every case; the male of the partridge is called يعقوب. كُلًّا: accusative governed by هدينا. وَنُوحاً: accusative governed by the second هدينا. وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ داوُدَ وَسُلَيْمانَ: al-Farrāʾ said it is conjoined to نوح, and al-Akhfash said it is conjoined to إسحاق, and likewise وَأَيُّوبَ and what follows it. داود is a diptote because it is a foreign name, and every name on the pattern fāʿūl to which alif and lām are not well suited is a diptote. سليمان is a foreign name; it may also be derived from السلامة, and it is a diptote because it has an added alif and nūn. أيوب is a foreign name, and likewise يوسف. Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif and ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar read وَيُوسُفَ with a kasra on the sīn.
